title: On Remaining only a promise in the book
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：remain　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 remain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the coach ① remained only a promise in the book in silence, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② remains only a promise in the book twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ remain only a promise in the book at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ remained only a promise in the book before — a line in the record for April 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Remaining only a promise in the book in silence, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ remain behind when the rest left twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Remain behind when the rest left at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ remains behind when the rest left in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ remained only a promise in the book again when nobody else would.

⑩ To remain only a promise in the book, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody remains only a promise in the book twice over again and somebody must remain only a promise in the book in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 仍然是（一般过去式 remained only a promise in the book：1988 年教练头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 仍然是（一般现在 remains only a promise in the book：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 仍然是（不定式 to remain only a promise in the book：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 仍然是（过去完成时 had remained only a promise in the book：1982 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 仍然是（动名词 remaining only a promise in the book 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 留下（remain behind when the rest left：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去留下别人都走后独自留下）
G. v. 留下（remain behind when the rest left：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 仍然是（后段两处：新来的队员照例 remains behind when the rest left，而母亲又一次 remained only a promise in the book）

answers.why: remain 意为“仍然是”，1988 年教练一言不发地仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺，那是球场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 remained。
remain 意为“仍然是”，自那以后教练来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 remains。
remain 意为“仍然是”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺”，此处为不定式 to remain only a promise in the book。
remain 意为“仍然是”，赛事记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人仍然是过，故用过去完成时 had remained。
remain 意为“仍然是”，教练说“仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 remaining only a promise in the book 作主语。
remain 意为“留下”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去留下别人都走后独自留下”，should ever 之后用原形 remain behind when the rest left。
remain 意为“留下”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻留下别人都走后独自留下（remain behind when the rest left at once），以后再也不要提起。
remain 意为“仍然是”，新来的队员每个赛季都照例留下别人都走后独自留下，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 remains。
remain 意为“仍然是”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺，用一般过去式 remained 叙述。
remain 意为“仍然是”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，教练一言不发地仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺；球场里每一个队员都说这是头一回。（remained only a promise in the book）
多年以后，教练仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（remains only a promise in the book）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺这件事本身。（to remain only a promise in the book）
早在 1982 年就有人仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺，四月那天赛事记录上的一行字就是证据。（had remained only a promise in the book）
教练说过，一言不发地仍然是在簿子上仍旧只是一句许诺这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（remaining only a promise in the book 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻留下别人都走后独自留下，以后再也不要提起。（remain behind when the rest left，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 remain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the coach remained only a promise in the book in silence, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach remains only a promise in the book twice over whenever the field asks.
Remaining only a promise in the book in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever remain behind when the rest left twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field remains behind when the rest left in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother remained only a promise in the book again, and the field remembered that half.
